nextReadySlice.title: Manifest required-field parser validation tests
failingProof: A failing proof shows required envelope fields such as schemaVersion, app, generator, or required strings are not yet covered by explicit parser-validation tests even though snapshots currently pass.
A failing proof shows malformed required-field JSON can still slip past the test suite without a direct contract-level assertion.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop again for review before broader hosted/tooling inspection work if required-field validation changes the approved manifest contract or reveals contract drift that needs a design decision.
